r=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
for i,m in enumerate(['other','baseline dot','space','hyphen'],80):

a[8]['confidence']='low'; a[8]['note']='Stroke length near category boundary.'

b=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(r)==len(b)==84
assert [x['item_id'] for x in r]==[x['item_id'] for x in b]
assert len({x['item_id'] for x in b})==84
for x,y in zip(r,b):
 assert y['answer'] in x['options']
 assert y['confidence'] in ('high','low')
 assert set(y)=={'item_id','answer','confidence','note'}
print('Validated count, order, unique IDs, option letters, and fields:',len(b))
c=collections.Counter(x['options'][y['answer']] for x,y in zip(r,b))
for m in ['raised dot','baseline dot','comma','hyphen','en dash','em dash','space','nothing','other','unreadable']: print(m,c[m])
